units.zh: 《易》曰：「有天地然後有萬物，有萬物然後有男女，有男女然後有夫婦。」
units.en: The Book of Changes says: "Once heaven and earth exist, the myriad things follow; once the myriad things exist, male and female follow; once male and female exist, husband and wife follow."
units.literal: The Book of Changes says: "When there are heaven and earth, then there are the myriad things; when there are the myriad things, then there are male and female; when there are male and female, then there are husband and wife."

units.zh: 夫婦之義尚矣哉！
units.en: How exalted is the meaning of husband and wife!
units.literal: The meaning of husband and wife—how exalted it is!

units.zh: 周禮，王者立后六宮，三夫人、九嬪、二十七世婦、八十一御妻，以聽天下之內治。
units.en: The Rites of Zhou say the king set up an empress and six inner palaces—three consorts, nine concubines, twenty-seven palace ladies, and eighty-one attendants—to govern affairs within the realm.
units.literal: In the Rites of Zhou, the king established the empress and the six inner palaces—three consorts, nine imperial concubines, twenty-seven palace ladies, and eighty-one palace attendants—to oversee inner governance throughout the realm.

units.zh: 故《昏義》云：「天子之與后，猶日之與月，陰之與陽，相須而成者也。」
units.en: So the "Meaning of Marriage" says the Son of Heaven and the empress are like sun and moon, yin and yang, completing one another.
units.literal: Hence the "Meaning of Marriage" says: "The Son of Heaven and the empress are like sun and moon, yin and yang—they need each other to be complete."

units.zh: 漢初因秦稱號，帝母稱皇太后，后稱皇后，而加以美人、良人、八子、七子之屬。
units.en: Early Han kept Qin titles: the emperor's mother was empress dowager, his consort empress, with further ranks of beauty, good person, eighth son, seventh son, and the like.
units.literal: At the beginning of Han, titles followed Qin usage: the emperor's mother was called empress dowager, his chief consort empress, with additional ranks such as beauty, good person, eighth son, and seventh son.

units.zh: 至孝武制婕妤之徒凡十四等。
units.en: Under Emperor Xiaowu the ranks from talented attendant onward reached fourteen grades in all.
units.literal: By Emperor Xiaowu's time the system of ranks including talented attendant and the like totaled fourteen grades.

units.zh: 降及魏、晉，母后之號，皆因漢法；
units.en: Through Wei and Jin, titles for imperial mothers all followed Han precedent;
units.literal: Down through Wei and Jin, titles for imperial mothers all followed Han law;

units.zh: 自夫人以下，世有增損焉。
units.en: below the rank of consort, each age revised the roster.
units.literal: from consort downward, each generation added or reduced ranks.

units.zh: 高祖撥亂反正，深鑒奢逸，惡衣菲食，務先節儉。
units.en: Gaozu ended chaos and restored rule, deeply wary of extravagance, preferring coarse dress and plain fare and putting thrift first.
units.literal: Emperor Gaozu quelled disorder and restored order, taking deep warning from luxury and excess, wearing poor clothes and eating plain food, putting frugality first.

units.zh: 配德早終，長秋曠位，嬪嬙之數，無所改作。
units.en: His worthy partner died young; the empress's seat stayed vacant; the roster of palace women was not revised.
units.literal: His worthy consort died early; the office of empress stood empty; the numbers of palace women were left unchanged.

units.zh: 太宗、世祖出自儲藩，而妃並先殂，又不建椒閫。
units.en: Taizong and Shizu rose from the heir's household, but their consorts died first and neither raised an empress.
units.literal: Emperor Taizong and Emperor Shizu came up from the heir's establishment, yet their consorts all died first, and neither established an empress.

units.zh: 今之撰錄，止備闕云。
units.en: This record therefore fills only the gaps.
units.literal: The present compilation supplies only what is missing.

units.zh: 太祖張皇后
units.en: Empress Zhang of Taizu
units.literal: Empress Zhang of Taizu

units.zh: 太祖獻皇后張氏，諱尚柔，范陽方城人也。
units.en: Taizu's Honored Empress Zhang, taboo name Shangrou, came from Fangcheng in Fanyang.
units.literal: Taizu's Honored Empress, the Zhang clan, taboo name Shangrou, was a native of Fangcheng in Fanyang.

units.zh: 祖次惠，宋濮陽太守。
units.en: Her grandfather Cihui served Song as Administrator of Puyang.
units.literal: Her grandfather Cihui was Administrator of Puyang under Song.

units.zh: 后母蕭氏，卽文帝從姑。
units.en: The empress's mother was a Xiao, a cousin of Emperor Wen on the paternal line.
units.literal: The empress's mother was of the Xiao clan—that is, an aunt on Emperor Wen's side.

units.zh: 后，宋元嘉中嬪於文帝，生長沙宣武王懿、永陽昭王敷，次生高祖。
units.en: In Song's Yuanjia era she entered Emperor Wen's harem and bore Yi, Prince Xuanwu of Changsha, Fu, Prince Zhao of Yongyang, and later Gaozu.
units.literal: In Yuanjia of Song she became a consort to Emperor Wen and bore Yi, Prince Xuanwu of Changsha, Fu, Prince Zhao of Yongyang, and afterward bore Gaozu.

units.zh: 初，后嘗於室內，忽見庭前昌蒲生花，光彩照灼，非世中所有。
units.en: Once, while the empress was indoors, she suddenly saw calamus blooming before the courtyard, radiant and dazzling beyond anything in the world.
units.literal: At first, the empress was once indoors when she suddenly saw calamus blooming before the courtyard, its radiance bright and dazzling, unlike anything in the world.

units.zh: 后驚視，謂侍者曰：「汝見不？」
units.en: Startled, the empress looked and asked her attendant, "Do you see it?"
units.literal: The empress looked in surprise and said to her attendant, "Do you see it?"

units.zh: 對曰：「不見。」
units.en: The attendant replied, "I do not."
units.literal: The attendant replied, "I do not see it."

units.zh: 后曰：「嘗聞見者當富貴。」
units.en: The empress said, "I have heard that whoever sees such a thing is destined for wealth and honor."
units.literal: The empress said, "I have heard that one who sees such a thing will become rich and noble."

units.zh: 因遽取吞之。
units.en: She immediately took it and swallowed it.
units.literal: Thereupon she hurriedly took it and swallowed it.

units.zh: 是月產高祖。
units.en: That month she gave birth to Gaozu.
units.literal: That month she gave birth to Gaozu.

units.zh: 將產之夜，后見庭內若有衣冠陪列焉。
units.en: On the night before the birth, the empress saw what looked like robed and capped attendants lined up in the courtyard.
units.literal: On the night when she was about to give birth, the empress saw in the courtyard what seemed to be robed and capped attendants arrayed there.

units.zh: 次生衡陽宣王暢、義興昭長公主令嫕。
units.en: She next bore Chang, Prince Xuan of Hengyang, and Lingyi, Senior Princess Zhao of Yixing.
units.literal: Afterward she gave birth to Prince Xuan Chang of Hengyang and Senior Princess Zhao Lingyi of Yixing.

units.zh: 宋泰始七年，殂于秣陵縣同夏里舍，葬武進縣東城里山。
units.en: In the seventh year of Song Taishi, she died at the residence in Tongxia Ward, Moling County, and was buried on Dongchengli Mountain in Wujin County.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Song Taishi, she died at the residence in Tongxia ward, Moling county, and was buried at Dongchengli Mountain in Wujin county.

units.zh: 天監元年五月甲辰，追上尊號爲皇后。
units.en: In the fifth month of Tianjian 1, on jiachen day, she was posthumously elevated as empress.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Tianjian, on jiachen day, an exalted title was posthumously presented to her as empress.

units.zh: 諡曰獻。
units.en: Her posthumous title was Xian.
units.literal: Her posthumous title was Xian.

units.zh: 父穆之，字思靜，晉司空華六世孫。
units.en: Her father Muzhi, styled Sijing, was a sixth-generation descendant of Jin's Minister of Works Hua.
units.literal: Her father Muzhi, styled Sijing, was sixth-generation descendant of Jin Minister of Works Hua.

units.zh: 曾祖輿坐華誅，徙興古，未至召還。
units.en: Her great-grandfather Yu was condemned in Hua's case, exiled toward Xinggu, and recalled before he arrived.
units.literal: Her great-grandfather Yu was implicated in Hua's execution, banished to Xinggu, recalled before he arrived.

units.zh: 及過江，爲丞相掾，太子舍人。
units.en: After crossing south he was a chancellor's aide and a crown prince attendant.
units.literal: After crossing the Yangtze he served as aide to the chancellor and as attendant to the crown prince.

units.zh: 穆之少方雅，有識鑒。
units.en: Muzhi in youth was upright and elegant, with keen judgment.
units.literal: Muzhi in youth was square and refined, with discernment.

units.zh: 宋元嘉中，爲員外散騎侍郎。
units.en: In Song's Yuanjia era he became an outer member of the Scattered Cavalry.
units.literal: In Yuanjia of Song he was made Outer Member of the Scattered Cavalry.

units.zh: 與吏部尚書江湛、太子左率袁淑善，淑薦之於始興王濬，濬深引納焉。
units.en: He was close to Minister of the Civil Service Jiang Zhan and the heir's left leader Yuan Shu; Shu recommended him to Prince Jun of Shixing, and Jun took him in warmly.
units.literal: He was on good terms with Minister of the Civil Service Jiang Zhan and Left Leader of the Heir's Household Yuan Shu; Shu recommended him to Prince Jun of Shixing, and Jun warmly received him.

units.zh: 穆之鑒其禍萌，思違其難，言於湛求外出。
units.en: Muzhi saw trouble brewing and sought a way out; he asked Zhan to post him away.
units.literal: Muzhi saw the disaster sprouting and thought to escape the trouble; he spoke to Zhan asking to be sent out.

units.zh: 湛將用爲東縣，固乞遠郡，久之，得爲寧遠將軍、交阯太守。
units.en: Zhan meant to place him in an eastern county, but he begged for a distant commandery and, after long delay, became General Pacifying the Distance and Administrator of Jiaozhi.
units.literal: Zhan was about to use him in an eastern county; he firmly begged for a distant commandery, and after long delay became General Pacifying the Distance and Administrator of Jiaozhi.

units.zh: 治有異績。
units.en: He governed with outstanding results.
units.literal: His administration showed exceptional achievement.

units.zh: 會刺史死，交土大亂，穆之威懷循拊，境內以寧。
units.en: When the inspector died, Jiaozhi erupted in chaos; Muzhi won men by authority and kindness, and the region grew calm.
units.literal: When the inspector died, Jiaozhi fell into great disorder; Muzhi by awe and kindness guided and comforted them, and within the borders there was peace.

units.zh: 宋文帝聞之嘉焉，將以爲交州刺史，會病卒。
units.en: Emperor Wen of Song heard and praised him and was about to make him Inspector of Jiaozhi, but Muzhi fell ill and died.
units.literal: Emperor Wen of Song heard and praised this, and was about to make him Inspector of Jiaozhi, but Muzhi fell ill and died.

units.zh: 子弘籍，字真藝，齊初爲鎮西參軍，卒於官。
units.en: His son Hongji, styled Zhenyi, in early Qi served as staff officer to the Pacify West army and died in office.
units.literal: His son Hongji, styled Zhenyi, in early Qi was staff officer to the Pacify West army and died in office.

units.zh: 高祖踐阼，追贈穆之光祿大夫，加金章。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Muzhi was posthumously made Glory Grand Master with a gold seal.
units.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, Muzhi was posthumously made Glory Grand Master with gold seal.

units.zh: 又詔曰：「亡舅齊鎮西參軍，素風雅猷，夙肩名輩，降年不永，早世潛輝。
units.en: Another edict said: "My late uncle, Qi's Pacify West staff officer, bore pure taste and fine counsel and long stood among eminent men; his years were short and his light went under early.
units.literal: Another edict said: "The deceased uncle, Qi staff officer to the Pacify West army, had pure style and elegant counsel, from of old shoulder to shoulder with famous men; his years were not long, early leaving the world his light hid.

units.zh: 朕少離苦辛，情地彌切，雖宅相克成，輅車靡贈，興言永往，觸目慟心。
units.en: I knew bitter separation in youth and feel the bond all the more; though tombs were raised, no carriage of gifts went forth, and every thought of his going wrings the heart.
units.literal: I in youth parted from bitter hardship, kin feeling ever keener; though dwelling tombs were mutually accomplished, touring carriage had no gift-offering, words rising at eternal parting, the eye touched brings anguished heart.

units.zh: 可追贈廷尉卿。」
units.en: Let him be posthumously made Minister of Justice."
units.literal: He may be posthumously made Minister of Justice."

units.zh: 弘籍無子，從父弟弘策以第三子纘爲嗣，別有傳。
units.en: Hongji had no son; his cousin Hongce made his third son Zuan the heir—see the separate biography.
units.literal: Hongji had no son; his father's younger brother's son Hongce made his third son Zuan heir—treated in a separate biography.

units.zh: 高祖郗皇后
units.en: Empress Xi of Gaozu
units.literal: Empress Xi of Gaozu

units.zh: 高祖德皇后郗氏，諱徽，高平金鄉人也。
units.en: Gaozu's Virtuous Empress Xi, taboo name Hui, came from Jinxiang in Gaoping.
units.literal: Gaozu's Virtuous Empress, the Xi clan, taboo name Hui, was a native of Jinxiang in Gaoping.

units.zh: 祖紹，國子祭酒，領東海王師。
units.en: Her grandfather Shao was Sacrificer of the Imperial Academy and tutor to the Prince of Donghai.
units.literal: Her grandfather Shao was Sacrificer of the Imperial Academy and concurrently tutor to the Prince of Donghai.

units.zh: 父燁，太子舍人，早卒。
units.en: Her father Ye was a crown prince attendant and died young.
units.literal: Her father Ye was attendant to the crown prince and died early.

units.zh: 初，后母尋陽公主方娠，夢當生貴子。
units.en: Before the empress was born, her mother the Princess of Xunyang dreamed she would bear a child of rank.
units.literal: At first, when the empress's mother the Princess of Xunyang was pregnant, she dreamed she would bear an honored child.

units.zh: 及生后，有赤光照于室內，器物盡明，家人皆怪之。
units.en: At her birth red light filled the room and every object shone bright; the household marveled.
units.literal: When the empress was born, red light filled the chamber and every object gleamed; the family all marvelled.

units.zh: 巫言此女光採異常，將有所妨，乃於水濱祓除之。
units.en: A shaman said the girl's brilliance was abnormal and would bring harm, so they purified her by the water.
units.literal: A shaman said this girl's radiance was extraordinary and would bring harm; they performed purification rites by the waterside.

units.zh: 后幼而明慧，善隸書，讀史傳。
units.en: From childhood she was clever and bright, skilled at clerical script, and read histories.
units.literal: The empress from childhood was clever and bright, skilled at clerical script, and read histories and records.

units.zh: 女工之事，無不閑習。
units.en: Of women's crafts there was none she had not mastered.
units.literal: Women's crafts—there was none she did not know intimately.

units.zh: 宋後廢帝將納爲后；
units.en: The deposed emperor of Later Song meant to make her empress;
units.literal: Deposed Emperor of Later Song was about to take her as empress;

units.zh: 齊初，安陸王緬又欲婚：郗氏並辭以女疾，乃止。
units.en: in early Qi Prince Mian of Anlu also sought her hand; the Xi clan pleaded illness both times, and the matches ended.
units.literal: in early Qi Prince Mian of Anlu also wished to marry her: the Xi clan both declined on grounds of the daughter's illness, and it stopped.

units.zh: 建元未，高祖始娉焉。
units.en: Near the end of Jianyuan Gaozu first took her as his wife.
units.literal: At the end of Jianyuan Gaozu first betrothed her.

units.zh: 生永興公主玉姚，永世公主玉婉，永康公主玉嬛。
units.en: She bore Princess Yuyao of Yongxing, Princess Yuwan of Yongshi, and Princess Yuhuan of Yongkang.
units.literal: She bore Princess Yuyao of Yongxing, Princess Yuwan of Yongshi, Princess Yuhuan of Yongkang.

units.zh: 建武五年，高祖爲雍州刺史，先之鎮，後乃迎后。
units.en: In Jianwu 5, when Gaozu became inspector of Yongzhou, he went to his post first and welcomed the empress afterward.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Jianwu, when Gaozu became inspector of Yongzhou, he first went to his garrison and only afterward welcomed the empress.

units.zh: 至州未幾，永元元年八月殂于襄陽官舍，時年三十二。
units.en: Not long after reaching the province, she died in the official residence at Xiangyang in the eighth month of Yongyuan 1, aged thirty-two.
units.literal: Not long after she reached the province, in the eighth month of the first year of Yongyuan, she died at the official residence in Xiangyang, aged thirty-two.

units.zh: 其年歸葬南徐州南東海武進縣東城里山。
units.en: That year her remains were returned for burial on Dongchengli Mountain in Wujin county, South Donghai commandery, South Xuzhou.
units.literal: That year she was returned for burial at Dongchengli Mountain in Wujin county, South Donghai, South Xuzhou.

units.zh: 中興二年，齊朝進高祖位相國，封十郡，梁公，詔贈后爲梁公妃。
units.en: In Zhongxing 2, the Qi court advanced Gaozu to chancellor of state and enfeoffed him over ten commanderies as Duke of Liang; by edict, she was posthumously made consort of the Duke of Liang.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhongxing, the Qi court advanced Gaozu to the post of chancellor of state and enfeoffed him over ten commanderies as Duke of Liang; an edict posthumously presented the empress as consort of the Duke of Liang.

units.zh: 高祖踐阼，追崇爲皇后。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, she was posthumously honored as empress.
units.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, she was posthumously exalted as empress.

units.zh: 有司議諡，吏部尚書兼右僕射臣約議曰：「表號垂名，義昭不朽。
units.en: When the offices deliberated on her posthumous title, your servant Yue, minister of personnel and acting right vice director, argued: "To set forth a title and pass down a name makes the principle of immortality clear.
units.literal: The responsible offices deliberated on her posthumous title, and your servant Yue, minister of personnel and acting right vice director, stated in deliberation: "To display a title and transmit a name is a principle that makes immortality manifest.

units.zh: 先皇后應祥月德，比載坤靈，柔範陰化，儀形自遠。
units.en: The late empress answered auspicious signs and lunar virtue, bearing the spirit of Earth; her gentle model and womanly influence formed an example that reached far.
units.literal: The former empress answered auspiciousness and lunar virtue, matched and bore the spirit of Earth; her gentle model and yin transformation, her form and example, reached far of themselves.

units.zh: 俔天作合，義先造舟，而神猷夙掩，所隔升運。
units.en: Heaven made the match and the rite preceded the crossing, yet her divine course was hidden early, cutting her off from the dynasty's rising fortune.
units.literal: As Heaven made the match, the rite preceded the building of boats, yet her divine plan was early hidden, and she was separated from the rising fortune.

units.zh: 宜式遵景行，用昭大典。
units.en: We should follow her luminous conduct as our model and make the great ceremony clear.
units.literal: It is proper to follow her bright conduct as a model and thereby make the great ceremony manifest.

units.zh: 謹按《諡法》，忠和純備曰德，貴而好禮曰德。
units.en: According to the Rules for Posthumous Titles, one loyal, harmonious, pure, and complete is called De; one noble and fond of ritual is also called De.
units.literal: I respectfully note that according to the Rules for Posthumous Titles, loyal, harmonious, pure, and complete is called De; noble yet loving ritual is called De.

units.zh: 宜崇曰德皇后。」
units.en: She should be honored as Empress De."
units.literal: She should be exalted as Empress De."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The edict followed this recommendation.
units.literal: The edict followed this.

units.zh: 陵曰脩陵。
units.en: Her mausoleum was called Xiuling.
units.literal: Her mausoleum was called Xiuling.

units.zh: 后父燁，詔贈金紫光祿大夫。
units.en: The empress's father Ye was posthumously made Glory Grand Master with purple insignia by edict.
units.literal: The empress's father Ye was by edict posthumously made Glory Grand Master with purple insignia.

units.zh: 燁尚宋文帝女尋陽公主，齊初降封松滋縣君。
units.en: Ye had married Emperor Wen of Song's daughter, the Princess of Xunyang; in early Qi she was reduced to Lady of Songzi county.
units.literal: Ye had married Emperor Wen of Song's daughter the Princess of Xunyang; in early Qi he was demoted to Lady of Songzi county.

units.zh: 燁子泛，中軍臨川王記室參軍。
units.en: Ye's son Fan was secretary to the Central Army's Prince of Linchuan.
units.literal: Ye's son Fan was secretary to Prince Linchuan of the Central Army.

units.zh: 太宗王皇后
units.en: Empress Wang of Taizong
units.literal: Empress Wang of Taizong

units.zh: 太宗簡皇后王氏，諱靈賓，琅邪臨沂人也。
units.en: Taizong's Honored Empress Wang, taboo name Lingbin, came from Linyi in Langye.
units.literal: Taizong's Honored Empress, the Wang clan, taboo name Lingbin, was a native of Linyi in Langye.

units.zh: 祖儉，太尉、南昌文憲公。
units.en: Her grandfather Jian was Grand Commandant and Duke of Nanchang, posthumous name Wenxian.
units.literal: Her grandfather Jian was Grand Commandant and Duke of Nanchang, posthumous name Wenxian.

units.zh: 后幼而柔明淑德，叔父暕見之曰：「吾家女師也。」
units.en: From youth the empress was gentle, intelligent, and virtuous. When her uncle Jian saw her, he said, "She is the model woman of our house."
units.literal: From youth the empress was gentle, bright, and virtuous; when her uncle Jian saw her, he said, "She is the female model of our house."

units.zh: 天監十一年，拜晉安王妃。
units.en: In Tianjian 11, she was appointed consort of the Prince of Jin'an.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Tianjian, she was appointed consort of the Prince of Jin'an.

units.zh: 生哀太子大器，南郡王大連，長山公主妙䂮。
units.en: She bore Daqi, Crown Prince Ai, Dalian, Prince of Nanjun, and the Princess of Changshan, whose personal name was written Miao followed by the rare graph U+40AE.
units.literal: She gave birth to Crown Prince Ai Daqi, Prince Dalian of Nanjun, and the Princess of Changshan, whose personal name was written Miao followed by the rare graph U+40AE.

units.zh: 中大通三年十月，拜皇太子妃。
units.en: In the tenth month of Zhongdatong 3, she was appointed crown princess.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Zhongdatong, she was appointed crown princess.

units.zh: 太清三年三月，薨于永福省，時年四十五。
units.en: In the third month of Taiqing 3, she died at Yongfu Office, aged forty-five.
units.literal: In the third month of the third year of Taiqing, she died at Yongfu Office, aged forty-five.

units.zh: 其年，太宗卽位，追崇爲皇后，諡曰簡。
units.en: That year Taizong took the throne and posthumously honored her as empress, with the title Jian.
units.literal: That year, when Taizong took the throne, she was posthumously exalted as empress, with the posthumous title Jian.

units.zh: 大寶元年九月，葬莊陵。
units.en: In the ninth month of Dabao 1, she was buried in Zhuangling.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Dabao, she was buried in Zhuangling.

units.zh: 先是詔曰：「簡皇后窀穸有期。
units.en: Before this, an edict said: "The time has been set for Empress Jian's burial.
units.literal: Before this, an edict said: "The interment of Empress Jian has its appointed time.

units.zh: 昔西京霸陵，因山爲藏；
units.en: In the past, Baling in the Western Capital used the mountain itself as the tomb;
units.literal: Formerly, at Baling of the Western Capital, the mountain was used as the tomb;

units.zh: 東漢壽陵，流水而已。
units.en: at Shouling of the Eastern Han, there was nothing more than flowing water.
units.literal: at Shouling of the Eastern Han, there was only flowing water.

units.zh: 朕屬值時艱，歲饑民弊，方欲以身率下，永示敦朴。
units.en: We have met difficult times: the year is hungry and the people worn down. We wish to lead those below by personal example and show lasting sincerity and simplicity.
units.literal: We have encountered hard times; the year is hungry and the people exhausted. We now wish to lead those below by Our own person and forever show sincerity and simplicity.

units.zh: 今所營莊陵，務存約儉。」
units.en: In building Zhuangling, keep strictly to restraint and frugality."
units.literal: Now in constructing Zhuangling, be sure to preserve restraint and frugality."

units.zh: 又詔金紫光祿大夫蕭子范爲哀策文。
units.en: Another edict ordered Xiao Zifan, grand master for splendid happiness with gold seal and purple ribbon, to compose the mourning elegy.
units.literal: Another edict ordered Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon Xiao Zifan to compose the mourning elegy.

units.zh: 父騫，字思寂，本名玄成，與齊高帝偏諱同，故改焉。
units.en: Her father Qian, styled Siji, was originally named Xuancheng; because the name clashed with Qi Gaozu's partial taboo, he changed it.
units.literal: Her father Qian, styled Siji, original name Xuancheng, shared a partial taboo with Qi Gaozu and therefore changed it.

units.zh: 以公子起家員外郎，遷太子洗馬，襲封南昌縣公，出爲義興太守。
units.en: He entered office as a noble's son, became an outer member, then attendant for the heir's wash horses, succeeded as Marquis of Nanchang county, and went out as Administrator of Yixing.
units.literal: Entering office as son of a noble he was outer member, promoted attendant to wash horses of the heir, succeeded as Marquis of Nanchang county, went out as Administrator of Yixing.

units.zh: 還爲驃騎諮議，累遷黃門郎，司徒右長史。
units.en: On return he advised the Rapid Cavalry general, then rose through Gentlemen of the Yellow Gate to Right Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education.
units.literal: Returning he became advisory officer to the Rapid Cavalry general, rising through posts to Gentlemen of the Yellow Gate and Right Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education.

units.zh: 性凝簡，不狎當世。
units.en: By nature he was austere and plain and kept aloof from his times.
units.literal: By nature he was reserved and simple, not familiar with the age.

units.zh: 嘗從容謂諸子曰：「吾家門戶，所謂素族，自可隨流平進，不須苟求也。」
units.en: Once he told his sons at ease: "Our house is a plain clan; one may drift with the current and advance evenly—there is no need to scramble for rank."
units.literal: Once at leisure he told his sons: "Our family's gate is what is called a plain clan; one may simply drift with the stream and advance evenly—there is no need to seek advancement recklessly."

units.zh: 永元末，遷侍中，不拜。
units.en: At the end of Yongyuan he was offered Palace Attendant but refused the post.
units.literal: At the end of Yongyuan he was moved to Palace Attendant but did not accept.

units.zh: 高祖霸府建，引爲大司馬諮議參軍，俄遷侍中，領越騎校尉。
units.en: When Gaozu set up his hegemony office, Qian was called in as Grand Marshal adviser, soon made Palace Attendant and Colonel of the Yue Cavalry.
units.literal: When Gaozu established his hegemony office, Qian was summoned as advisory officer to the Grand Marshal, soon promoted Palace Attendant and concurrently Colonel of the Yue Cavalry.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，詔曰：「庭堅世祀，靡輟於宗周，樂毅錫壤，乃昭於洪漢。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, an edict said: "Jianting's line was never cut off in the Zhou royal house; Yue Yi received a fief and shone in great Han.
units.literal: When Gaozu received the mandate, an edict said: "Jianting's generations of sacrifice never ceased in the Zhou of the clan; Yue Yi received lands and shone forth in great Han.

units.zh: 齊故太尉南昌公，含章履道，草昧興齊，謨明翊贊，同符在昔。
units.en: Qi's former Grand Commandant, Duke of Nanchang, bore talent and walked the Way, helped raise Qi from the wilds, and counseled with bright support like men of old.
units.literal: Qi's former Grand Commandant Duke of Nanchang bore his talent and trod the Way, in the wilds he raised Qi, his counsels bright and supportive, matching those of old.

units.zh: 雖子房之蔚爲帝師，文若之隆比王佐，無以尚也。
units.en: Though Zifang became the emperor's teacher and Wenruo rose as the king's right hand, none surpass him.
units.literal: Though Zifang stood eminent as emperor's teacher, Wenruo towered like king's helper—they cannot be surpassed.

units.zh: 朕膺歷受圖，惟新寶命，莘莘玉帛，升降有典。
units.en: I have received the mandate and renewed the imperial charge; gifts of silk now rise and fall by fixed ritual.
units.literal: I have received the mandate and renewed the jade command; the multitudes of silk offerings rise and fall with fixed ritual.

units.zh: 永言前代，敬惟徽烈，匪直懋勳，義兼懷樹。
units.en: Speaking always of former times, I revere his great glory—not for merit alone, but also in gratitude, as one cherishes a tree.
units.literal: Forever speaking of former ages, reverently thinking on his great glory—not only for meritorious toil, the meaning also embraces cherished trees.

units.zh: 可降封南昌公爲侯，食邑千戶。」
units.en: Let Duke of Nanchang be reduced to marquis with a fief of one thousand households."
units.literal: Duke of Nanchang may be demoted to marquis, fief of one thousand households."

units.zh: 騫襲爵，遷度支尚書。
units.en: Qian inherited the title and was made Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: Qian succeeded to the title, was moved to Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 天監四年，出爲東陽太守，尋徙吳郡。
units.en: In Tianjian year 4 he went out as Administrator of Dongyang, then was moved to Wu commandery.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tianjian he went out as Administrator of Dongyang, soon transferred to Wu commandery.

units.zh: 八年，入爲太府卿，領后軍將軍，遷太常卿。
units.en: In year 8 he entered as Minister of the Palace Treasury and Rear Army General, then became Minister of Ceremonies.
units.literal: In the eighth year he entered as Minister of the Palace Treasury, concurrently Rear Army General, then Minister of Ceremonies.

units.zh: 十一年，遷中書令，加員外散騎常侍。
units.en: In year 11 he became Palace Scribe with added outer membership in the Scattered Cavalry.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he was moved to Palace Scribe, with added Outer Member of the Scattered Cavalry.

units.zh: 時高祖於鐘山造大愛敬寺，騫舊墅在寺側，有良田八十餘頃，卽晉丞相王導賜田也。
units.en: Gaozu was building the Great Temple of Filial Reverence on Zhong Mountain; Qian's old villa lay beside it, with more than eighty qing of fine fields—the very grant of Jin chancellor Wang Dao.
units.literal: At the time Gaozu at Zhong Mountain built the Great Temple of Filial Reverence; Qian's old villa stood beside the temple, with more than eighty qing of good farmland—that very land the Jin chancellor Wang Dao had been granted.

units.zh: 高祖遣主書宣旨就騫求市，欲以施寺。
units.en: Gaozu sent a palace clerk with an imperial message to buy the land for the temple.
units.literal: Gaozu sent a palace clerk with imperial words to Qian to seek to buy it, intending to give it to the temple.

units.zh: 騫答旨云：「此田不賣；
units.en: Qian answered: "This land is not for sale;
units.literal: Qian answered the decree: "This land is not for sale;

units.zh: 若是敕取，所不敢言。」
units.en: if Your Majesty takes it by command, I dare not object."
units.literal: if it is taken by command, I dare say nothing."

units.zh: 酬對又脫略。
units.en: His replies were curt and careless besides.
units.literal: His replies were also curt and offhand.

units.zh: 高祖怒，遂付市評田價，以直逼還之。
units.en: Gaozu grew angry, had the market price assessed, and seized the land outright in return.
units.literal: Gaozu was angry, had the market assess the land price, and by direct seizure returned it.

units.zh: 由是忤旨，出爲吳興太守。
units.en: For this he lost favor and was sent out as Administrator of Wuxing.
units.literal: For this he offended the will and was sent out as Administrator of Wuxing.

units.zh: 在郡臥疾不視事。
units.en: In the commandery he took to his bed and left affairs unattended.
units.literal: In the commandery he lay ill and did not attend to affairs.

units.zh: 徵還，復爲度支尚書，加給事中，領射聲校尉。
units.en: Recalled, he again became Minister of Revenue, with added Supervising Censor and Colonel of the Archer Sound.
units.literal: Summoned back, again Minister of Revenue, with added Supervising Censor, concurrently Colonel of the Archer Sound.

units.zh: 以母憂去職。
units.en: He left office to mourn his mother.
units.literal: He left office on mourning for his mother.

units.zh: 普通三年十月卒，時年四十九。
units.en: In the tenth month of Putong year 3 he died at forty-nine.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Putong he died, age forty-nine.

units.zh: 詔贈侍中、金紫光祿大夫，諡曰安。
units.en: By edict he was posthumously made Palace Attendant and Glory Grand Master with purple insignia, posthumous name An.
units.literal: Edict posthumously made him Palace Attendant and Glory Grand Master with purple insignia, posthumous name An.

units.zh: 子規襲爵，別有傳。
units.en: His son Gui inherited the title—see the separate biography.
units.literal: His son Gui succeeded to the title—treated in a separate biography.

units.zh: 高祖丁貴嬪
units.en: Noble Consort Ding of Gaozu
units.literal: Noble Consort Ding of Gaozu

units.zh: 高祖丁貴嬪，諱令光，譙國人也，世居襄陽。
units.en: Gaozu's Noble Consort Ding, taboo name Lingguang, came from Qiao and had long lived at Xiangyang.
units.literal: Gaozu's Noble Consort Ding, taboo name Lingguang, was a native of Qiao state, her family for generations dwelling at Xiangyang.

units.zh: 貴嬪生于樊城，有神光之異，紫煙滿室，故以「光」爲名。
units.en: She was born at Fancheng amid a marvel of divine light and purple mist filling the room, and so "Guang" was placed in her name.
units.literal: The Noble Consort was born at Fancheng; there was a divine-light marvel, purple mist filling the chamber, and so "Guang" was put in her name.

units.zh: 相者云：「此女當大貴。」
units.en: A physiognomist said, "This girl will rise to great honor."
units.literal: A physiognomist said: "This girl will attain great honor."

units.zh: 高祖臨州，丁氏因人以聞。
units.en: When Gaozu held the province, the Ding clan sent word through others.
units.literal: When Gaozu was inspector of the province, the Ding clan had someone bring word.

units.zh: 貴嬪時年十四，高祖納焉。
units.en: The Noble Consort was then fourteen, and Gaozu took her in.
units.literal: The Noble Consort was then fourteen; Gaozu took her in.

units.zh: 初，貴嬪生而有赤痣在左臂，治之不滅，至是無何忽失所在。
units.en: At birth she had a red mole on her left arm that medicine could not erase; now, without cause, it suddenly vanished.
units.literal: At first the Noble Consort had been born with a red mole on her left arm; treatment could not remove it—now suddenly and for no reason it vanished.

units.zh: 事德皇后小心祗敬，嘗於供養經案之側，彷彿若見神人，心獨異之。
units.en: Serving the Virtuous Empress, she was careful and reverent; once beside the sutra offerings she seemed to see a spirit, and her heart alone was struck.
units.literal: In serving the Virtuous Empress she was careful and reverent; once beside the sutra case where offerings were made, it was as if she saw a spirit being, and her heart alone felt it strange.

units.zh: 高祖義師起，昭明太子始誕育，貴嬪與太子留在州城。
units.en: When Gaozu's righteous army rose and Crown Prince Zhaoming was newly born, the Noble Consort stayed in the provincial city with the heir.
units.literal: When Gaozu's righteous army rose, the Crown Prince Zhaoming was first born; the Noble Consort with the heir remained in the provincial city.

units.zh: 京邑平，乃還京都。
units.en: When the capital was pacified, she returned to the capital.
units.literal: When the capital region was pacified, she returned to the capital.

units.zh: 天監元年五月，有司奏爲貴人，未拜；
units.en: In the fifth month of Tianjian year 1 the relevant office memorialized to make her Honored Person, but the investiture had not yet been performed;
units.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Tianjian the relevant office memorialized to make her Honored Person—not yet invested;

units.zh: 其年八月，又爲貴嬪，位在三夫人上，居于顯陽殿。
units.en: that same year in the eighth month she became Noble Consort, ranking above the Three Consorts and dwelling in Xianyang Palace.
units.literal: that same year in the eighth month she became Noble Consort, rank above the Three Consorts, dwelling in Xianyang Palace.

units.zh: 及太子定位，有司奏曰：
units.en: When the crown prince's place was settled, the relevant office memorialized:
units.literal: When the crown prince's position was fixed, the relevant office memorialized:

units.zh: 禮，母以子貴。
units.en: Ritual says the mother is honored through the son.
units.literal: Ritual: the mother is honored through the son.

units.zh: 皇儲所生，不容無敬。
units.en: The mother of the royal heir cannot go without respect.
units.literal: She who bore the royal heir—one cannot fail to show her respect.

units.zh: 宋泰豫元年六月，議百官以吏敬敬帝所生陳太妃，則宋明帝在時，百官未有敬。
units.en: In the sixth month of Song's Taiyu year 1, officials debated showing clerkly respect to the emperor's birth mother, Honored Consort Chen—yet while Emperor Ming of Song lived, no official had shown such respect.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Taiyu of Song, it was debated whether all officials should with clerkly respect honor the Mother of the Emperor Chen, the Honored Consort—yet when Emperor Ming of Song was alive, officials had shown no such respect.

units.zh: 臣竊謂「母以子貴」，義著《春秋》。
units.en: Your servant holds that "the mother is honored through the son" is a principle set forth in the Spring and Autumn Annals.
units.literal: Your servant ventures that "the mother is honored through the son"—the meaning is set forth in the Spring and Autumn Annals.

units.zh: 皇太子副貳宸極，率土咸執吏禮，旣盡禮皇儲，則所生不容無敬。
units.en: The crown prince stands second only to the throne; all the realm performs the rites of subordinate officials. Once the heir is fully honored, his mother cannot go without honor.
units.literal: The crown prince stands second to the pole star; all within the seas perform the protocol of subordinate officials. Having done full ritual to the royal heir, one cannot withhold reverence toward her who bore him.

units.zh: 但帝王妃嬪，義與外隔，以理以例，無致敬之道也。
units.en: Yet imperial consorts are cut off by principle from the outer court; by reason and precedent there is no way to show formal reverence.
units.literal: Yet imperial consorts stand apart by principle from the outer court; by reason and precedent there is no path of formal reverence.

units.zh: 今皇太子聖睿在躬，儲禮夙備，子貴之道，抑有舊章。
units.en: Now the crown prince's wisdom is manifest and his heir's rites long in place—the way of exalting the mother through the son has old statutes after all.
units.literal: Now the crown prince's sage brilliance is in his person, the heir's rites long since prepared—the way of honoring the mother through the son indeed has old statutes.

units.zh: 王侯妃主常得通信問者，及六宮三夫人雖與貴嬪同列，並應以敬皇太子之禮敬貴嬪。
units.en: Princesses and feudal ladies who may ordinarily exchange messages, and the six palaces' three ladies of rank though equal to the honored consort—all should honor her with the same rites used for the crown prince.
units.literal: Princesses and feudal ladies who ordinarily may exchange messages, and the six palaces' three ladies of rank though equal to the honored consort in standing—all should use the same reverence shown the crown prince to revere the honored consort.

units.zh: 宋元嘉中，始興、武陵國臣並以吏敬敬所生潘淑妃、路淑媛。
units.en: In Song Yuanjia, ministers of Shixing and Wuling both used subordinate-official reverence toward their lords' mothers, Consort Pan and Lady Lu.
units.literal: In Yuanjia of Song, ministers of the principalities of Shixing and Wuling all used subordinate-official reverence toward their lords' mothers, Consorts Pan and Lady Lu.

units.zh: 貴嬪于宮臣雖非小君，其義不異，與宋泰豫朝議百官以吏敬敬帝所生，事義正同。
units.en: To palace officials the honored consort is not a lesser lord, yet the principle is the same; it matches the Song Taizong deliberation that all officials use subordinate reverence toward the emperor's mother.
units.literal: To palace officials the honored consort is not the lesser lord, yet the principle is unchanged; it matches exactly the Song Taizong-era deliberation that all officials use subordinate reverence toward the emperor's mother.

units.zh: 謂宮閹施敬宜同吏禮，詣神虎門奉牋致謁；
units.en: Palace eunuchs who show reverence should follow subordinate protocol, going to the Spirit Tiger Gate with memorial tablets to pay audience;
units.literal: It is proposed that eunuchs of the palace who show reverence should follow subordinate protocol, going to the Spirit Tiger Gate with memorial tablets to pay audience;

units.zh: 年節稱慶，亦同如此。
units.en: New Year felicitations should follow the same rule.
units.literal: New Year felicitations should follow the same rule.

units.zh: 婦人無閫外之事，賀及問訊牋什，所由官報聞而已。
units.en: Women have no affairs outside the inner quarter; congratulatory and inquiry memorials need only be reported by the responsible office.
units.literal: Women have no affairs outside the inner quarter; congratulatory and inquiry memorials should simply be reported by the responsible office.

units.zh: 夫婦人之道，義無自專，若不仰繫於夫，則當俯繫於子。
units.en: The way of wifehood allows no self-direction; if one does not look up to one's husband, one must look down to one's son.
units.literal: The way of wifehood allows no self-direction; if one does not look up and attach to one's husband, one must look down and attach to one's son.

units.zh: 榮親之道，應極其所榮，未有子所行而所從不足者也。
units.en: The way of honoring kin should reach the fullest honor due; never has the son's observance been matched by insufficient observance from those who follow him.
units.literal: The way of honoring kin should reach the fullest honor due; never has what the son practices been matched by insufficient observance from those who follow him.

units.zh: 故《春秋》凡王命爲夫人，則禮秩與子等。
units.en: Hence in the Spring and Autumn Annals, whenever the king appointed someone as lady, ritual rank equaled that of her sons.
units.literal: Hence in the Spring and Autumn Annals, whenever the king appointed someone as lady, ritual rank equaled that of her sons.

units.zh: 列國雖異於儲貳，而從尊之義不殊。
units.en: Among feudal states it differed from the heir apparent, yet the principle of following the honored was the same.
units.literal: Among feudal states it differed from the heir apparent, yet the principle of following the honored was the same.

units.zh: 前代依准，布在舊事。
units.en: Former generations' precedents are set forth in old records.
units.literal: Former generations' precedents are set forth in old records.

units.zh: 貴嬪載誕元良，克固大業，禮同儲君，實惟舊典。
units.en: The honored consort bore the primary heir and secured the great enterprise; ritual equal to the heir is indeed the old canon.
units.literal: The honored consort bore the primary heir and secured the great enterprise; ritual equal to the heir is indeed the old canon.

units.zh: 尋前代始置貴嬪，位次皇后，爵無所視；
units.en: Searching former ages, when the honored consort was first instituted, her place was second to the empress, with no comparable title;
units.literal: Searching former ages, when the honored consort was first instituted, her place was second to the empress, with no title to which others looked for comparison;

units.zh: 其次職者，位視相國，爵比諸侯王。
units.en: the next office below ranked with the chancellor of state, titles compared to feudal kings.
units.literal: the next office below viewed the chancellor of state in rank, titles compared to feudal kings.

units.zh: 此貴嬪之禮，已高朝列；
units.en: Even this ritual for the honored consort already stood above the court ranks;
units.literal: Even this ritual for the honored consort already stood above the court ranks;

units.zh: 況母儀春宮，義絕常算。
units.en: how much more when she is mother-exemplar of the eastern palace—the reckoning breaks ordinary measure.
units.literal: how much more when she is mother-exemplar of the eastern palace—the reckoning breaks ordinary measure.

units.zh: 且儲妃作配，率由盛則；
units.en: Moreover the heir's consort is paired by the grandest norms;
units.literal: Moreover the heir's consort is paired by the grandest norms;

units.zh: 以婦逾姑，彌乖從序。
units.en: for a daughter-in-law to outrank her husband's mother only further violates the order of submission.
units.literal: for a daughter-in-law to outrank her husband's mother only further violates the order of submission.

units.zh: 謂貴嬪典章，一與太子不異。
units.en: It is proposed that the honored consort's statutes and insignia be wholly without difference from the crown prince.
units.literal: It is proposed that the honored consort's statutes and insignia be wholly without difference from the crown prince.

units.zh: 於是貴嬪備典章禮數，同于太子，言則稱令。
units.en: Thereupon the honored consort was equipped with statutes and ritual numbers identical to the crown prince; in speech she was addressed as "Command."
units.literal: Thereupon the honored consort was equipped with statutes and ritual numbers identical to the crown prince; in speech she was addressed as "Command."

units.zh: 貴嬪性仁恕，及居宮內，接馭自下，皆得其歡心。
units.en: The honored consort was by nature kind and forgiving; once she dwelt within the palace, she received and guided those below and won all their hearts.
units.literal: The honored consort was by nature kind and forgiving; once she dwelt within the palace, she received and guided those below and won all their hearts.

units.zh: 不好華飾，器服無珍麗，未嘗爲親戚私謁。
units.en: She did not care for ornate dress; utensils and garments had no lavish gems; she never received private audiences for kin.
units.literal: She did not care for ornate dress; utensils and garments had no lavish gems; she never received private audiences for kin.

units.zh: 及高祖弘佛教，貴嬪奉而行之，屏絕滋腴，長進蔬膳。
units.en: When Gaozu spread Buddhism, the honored consort followed it, banishing rich foods and keeping to vegetables long term.
units.literal: When Gaozu spread Buddhism, the honored consort followed it, banishing rich foods and keeping to vegetables long term.

units.zh: 受戒日，甘露降于殿前，方一丈五尺。
units.en: On the day she received the precepts, sweet dew fell before the hall, a square of one zhang and five chi.
units.literal: On the day she received the precepts, sweet dew fell before the hall, a square of one zhang and five chi.

units.zh: 高祖所立經義，皆得其指歸。
units.en: Of the sutra meanings Gaozu established, she grasped every import.
units.literal: Of the sutra meanings Gaozu established, she grasped every import.

units.zh: 尤精《淨名經》。
units.en: She was especially versed in the Vimalakirti Sutra.
units.literal: She was especially versed in the Vimalakirti Sutra.

units.zh: 所受供賜，悉以充法事。
units.en: All stipends and gifts she received went entirely to Buddhist rites.
units.literal: All stipends and gifts she received went entirely to Buddhist rites.

units.zh: 普通七年十一月庚辰薨，殯於東宮臨雲殿，年四十二。
units.en: In the eleventh month, gengchen, year 7 of Putong, she died; her bier lay in the Eastern Palace's Cloud-Approach Hall; age forty-two.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, gengchen, year 7 of Putong, she died; her bier lay in the Eastern Palace's Cloud-Approach Hall; age forty-two.

units.zh: 詔吏部郎張纘爲哀策文曰：
units.en: An edict ordered Minister of Personnel Zhang Zuan to compose the lament-seal text, saying:
units.literal: An edict ordered Minister of Personnel Zhang Zuan to compose the lament-seal text, saying:

units.zh: 菆塗旣啓，桂樽虛凝，龍帷已薦，象服將升。
units.en: The funeral road opens; the cassia coffin waits empty and still. Dragon curtains are laid in offering; court robes are ready to be raised.
units.literal: The cypress path is opened, the cassia coffin stands void and still; the dragon curtains are offered up, the ceremonial robes are about to be raised.

units.zh: 皇帝傷璧台之永颭，悼曾城之不踐，罷鄉歌乎燕樂，廢徹齊於祀典。
units.en: The emperor mourns the jade terrace's banners drifting on, the high citadel he cannot climb; village songs of feast music cease, and sacrificial vessels go uncleared from the canon.
units.literal: The emperor grieves that the jade terrace's banners fly on forever, mourns that the lofty citadel may not be tread; he stops the village songs of Yan music, suspends the clearing of vessels from the sacrificial canon.

units.zh: 《風》有《采蘩》，化行南國，爰命史臣，俾流嬪德。
units.en: The Odes have "Gathering Eulalia," virtue spreading through the southern realm—so he charges the historiographer to carry her consort's virtue abroad.
units.literal: In the Odes there is "Gathering White Eulalia"; virtue flowed to the southern states—therefore he commands the historiographer to let the consort's virtue stream forth.

units.zh: 其辭曰：
units.en: The text says:
units.literal: The text says:

units.zh: 軒緯之精，江漢之英；
units.en: Essence of the pole star, splendor of the great rivers;
units.literal: Essence of the axis star, splendor of Yangtze and Han;

units.zh: 歸于君袂，生此離明。
units.en: she entered the ruler's embrace and bore this departing light.
units.literal: returning to the ruler's sleeve, she bore this departing radiance.

units.zh: 誕自厥初，時維載育；
units.en: From the first, her season was ripe with nurture;
units.literal: From her beginning, the season was full nurture;

units.zh: 樞電繞郊，神光照屋。
units.en: lightning coiled the suburbs; divine radiance filled the house.
units.literal: pivot-lightning coiled the suburbs, divine light filled the house.

units.zh: 爰及待年，含章早穆；
units.en: When she reached the age to wait upon marriage, grace was already complete;
units.literal: When she reached the age to wait upon marriage, grace was already complete;

units.zh: 聲被洽陽，譽宣中谷。
units.en: her fame reached the sunlit lands, her reputation spread through the central valley.
units.literal: her fame reached the sunlit lands, her reputation spread through the central valley.

units.zh: 龍德在田，聿恭茲祀；
units.en: Dragon virtue lay in the fields; she reverently attended this sacrifice;
units.literal: Dragon virtue lay in the fields; she reverently attended this sacrifice;

units.zh: 陰化代終，王風攸始。
units.en: feminine transformation succeeded the end, royal wind began.
units.literal: feminine transformation succeeded the end, royal wind began.

units.zh: 動容諮式，出言顧史；
units.en: bearing and expression followed the patterns, words departed to consult the histories;
units.literal: bearing and expression followed the patterns, words departed to consult the histories;

units.zh: 宜其家人，刑于國紀。
units.en: "Harmonize his household," she modeled the state's discipline.
units.literal: "Harmonize his household," she modeled the state's discipline.

units.zh: 膺斯眷命，從此宅心；
units.en: She received this charge of favor, from this took her dwelling of the heart;
units.literal: She received this charge of favor, from this took her dwelling of the heart;

units.zh: 狄綴采珩，珮動雅音。
units.en: Di bells strung colored studs, girdle-pendants moved with elegant sound.
units.literal: Di bells strung colored studs, girdle-pendants moved with elegant sound.

units.zh: 日中思戒，月滿懷箴；
units.en: At noon she pondered warnings, at the full moon she cherished admonitions;
units.literal: At noon she pondered warnings, at the full moon she cherished admonitions;

units.zh: 如何不跼，天高照臨。
units.en: how could she not be cramped? Heaven's height looked down.
units.literal: how could she not be cramped? Heaven's height looked down.

units.zh: 玄紞莫脩，褘章早缺；
units.en: The dark sash was not repaired, ceremonial robes early torn;
units.literal: The dark sash was not repaired, ceremonial robes early torn;

units.zh: 成物誰能，芳猷有烈。
units.en: who can complete the world's work? fragrant plans had blaze.
units.literal: who can complete the world's work? fragrant plans had blaze.

units.zh: 素魄貞明，紫宮照晰；
units.en: plain moon faithful and bright, purple palace clearly lit;
units.literal: plain moon faithful and bright, purple palace clearly lit;

units.zh: 逮下靡傷，思賢罔蔽。
units.en: reaching down without harm, thinking on worth without blindness.
units.literal: reaching down without harm, thinking on worth without blindness.

units.zh: 躬儉則節，昭事惟虔；
units.en: personal thrift was her rule, solemn service wholly devout;
units.literal: personal thrift was her rule, solemn service wholly devout;

units.zh: 金玉無玩，筐筥不捐。
units.en: gold and jade held no play, baskets and bamboo were never cast aside.
units.literal: gold and jade held no play, baskets and bamboo were never cast aside.

units.zh: 祥流德化，慶表親賢；
units.en: auspicious virtue flowed, celebration appeared for kin;
units.literal: auspicious virtue flowed, celebration appeared for kin;

units.zh: 甄昌軼啓，孕魯陶燕。
units.en: excellence ever opened, she nurtured Lu, molded Yan.
units.literal: excellence ever opened, she nurtured Lu, molded Yan.

units.zh: 方論婦教，明章閫席；
units.en: just as they discussed women's teaching, bright statutes for the inner seat—
units.literal: just as they discussed women's teaching, bright statutes for the inner seat—

units.zh: 玄池早扃，湘沅已穸。
units.en: the dark pool was barred early, Xiang and Yuan already silent.
units.literal: the dark pool was barred early, Xiang and Yuan already silent.

units.zh: 展衣委華，朱幩寢迹；
units.en: unfolding robes laid aside splendor, vermilion curtains covered her traces;
units.literal: unfolding robes laid aside splendor, vermilion curtains covered her traces;

units.zh: 慕結儲闈，哀深蕃辟。
units.en: longing knotted the heir's quarters, grief deep for the feudal ramparts.
units.literal: longing knotted the heir's quarters, grief deep for the feudal ramparts.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas—how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 令龜兆良，葆引遷祖；
units.en: Order the tortoise augury for a lucky day, lead the soul to move the ancestors;
units.literal: Order the tortoise augury for a lucky day, lead the soul to move the ancestors;

units.zh: 具僚次列，承華接武。
units.en: all officials ranked in order, Succession Flourishing lined shoulder to shoulder.
units.literal: all officials ranked in order, Succession Flourishing lined shoulder to shoulder.

units.zh: 日杳杳以霾春，風凄凄而結緒；
units.en: The sun dim and misted over spring, wind bleak and knotting grief;
units.literal: The sun dim and misted over spring, wind bleak and knotting grief;

units.zh: 去曾掖以依遲，飾新宮而延佇。
units.en: leaving the former side-wing she lingered in delay, adorning the new palace she prolonged her stay.
units.literal: leaving the former side-wing she lingered in delay, adorning the new palace she prolonged her stay.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas—how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 啓丹旗之星旆，振容車之黼裳；
units.en: Raise the scarlet banner's star pennant, shake the carriage's brocade hangings;
units.literal: Raise the scarlet banner's star pennant, shake the carriage's brocade hangings;

units.zh: 擬靈金而鬱楚，泛凄管而凝傷。
units.en: imitate the spirit bronze's Chu gloom, float the chill pipe's congealed sorrow.
units.literal: imitate the spirit bronze's Chu gloom, float the chill pipe's congealed sorrow.

units.zh: 遺備物乎營寢，掩重閽於窒皇；
units.en: remaining things left in the encampment hall, covering the heavy inner gates in silent dark;
units.literal: remaining things left in the encampment hall, covering the heavy inner gates in silent dark;

units.zh: 椒風暖兮猶昔，蘭殿幽而不陽。
units.en: pepper breeze warm as of old, orchid hall dim without sun.
units.literal: pepper breeze warm as of old, orchid hall dim without sun.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas—how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 側闈高義，彤管有懌；
units.en: the side gate's lofty righteousness, red tube had joy;
units.literal: the side gate's lofty righteousness, red tube had joy;

units.zh: 道變虞風，功參唐跡。
units.en: the Way changed Yu's wind, merit joined Tang's tracks.
units.literal: the Way changed Yu's wind, merit joined Tang's tracks.

units.zh: 婉如之人，休光赤舄；
units.en: a yielding such person, resting light on red slippers;
units.literal: a yielding such person, resting light on red slippers;

units.zh: 施諸天地，而無朝夕。
units.en: spread through heaven and earth, without morning or evening.
units.literal: spread through heaven and earth, without morning or evening.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas—how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 有司奏諡曰穆。
units.en: The responsible offices memorialized posthumous title: Mu.
units.literal: The responsible offices memorialized posthumous title: Mu.

units.zh: 太宗卽位，追崇曰穆太后。
units.en: When Emperor Taizong took the throne, she was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager Mu.
units.literal: When Emperor Taizong took the throne, she was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager Mu.

units.zh: 太后父仲遷，天監初，官至兗州刺史。
units.en: The empress dowager's father Zhongqian, in early Tianjian, reached office as inspector of Yan province.
units.literal: The empress dowager's father Zhongqian, in early Tianjian, reached office as inspector of Yan province.

units.zh: 高祖阮脩容
units.en: Gaozu's Ruan Xiurong
units.literal: Gaozu's Ruan Xiurong

units.zh: 高祖阮脩容諱令嬴，本姓石，會稽餘姚人也。
units.en: Gaozu's Ruan Xiurong, taboo name Lingying, born a Shi of Yuyao in Kuaiji.
units.literal: Gaozu's Ruan Xiurong, taboo name Lingying, originally surname Shi, was of Yuyao in Kuaiji.

units.zh: 齊始安王遙光納焉。
units.en: Qi's Prince of Shi'an, Yaoguang, took her to wife.
units.literal: Prince of Shi'an Yaoguang of Qi took her in marriage.

units.zh: 遙光敗，入東昏宮。
units.en: When Yaoguang fell, she was taken into the Depraved Emperor's palace.
units.literal: When Yaoguang was defeated, she entered the Depraved Emperor's palace.

units.zh: 建康城平，高祖納爲彩女。
units.en: When Jiankang fell, Gaozu took her as a painted attendant.
units.literal: When Jiankang fell, Gaozu took her as a painted attendant.

units.zh: 天監七年八月，生世祖。
units.en: In the eighth month, year 7 of Tianjian, she bore Shizu.
units.literal: In the eighth month, year 7 of Tianjian, she bore Shizu.

units.zh: 尋拜爲脩容，常隨世祖出蕃。
units.en: Soon she was appointed Xiurong, and often followed Shizu when he went out to his fief.
units.literal: Soon she was appointed Xiurong, and often followed Shizu when he went out to his fief.

units.zh: 大同六年六月，薨于江州內寢，時年六十七。
units.en: In the sixth month, year 6 of Datong, she died in the inner chamber at Jiang Province; age sixty-seven.
units.literal: In the sixth month, year 6 of Datong, she died in the inner chamber at Jiang Province; age sixty-seven.

units.zh: 其年十一月，歸葬江寧縣通望山。
units.en: That year in the eleventh month she was returned for burial at Tongwang Mountain in Jiangning county.
units.literal: That year in the eleventh month she was returned for burial at Tongwang Mountain in Jiangning county.

units.zh: 諡曰宣。
units.en: Posthumous title: Xuan.
units.literal: Posthumous title: Xuan.

units.zh: 世祖卽位，有司奏追崇爲文宣太后。
units.en: When Shizu took the throne, the responsible offices memorialized to posthumously honor her as Empress Dowager Wenxuan.
units.literal: When Shizu took the throne, the responsible offices memorialized to posthumously honor her as Empress Dowager Wenxuan.

units.zh: 承聖二年，追贈太后父齊故奉朝請靈寶散騎常侍、左衛將軍，封武康縣侯，邑五百戶；
units.en: In year 2 of Chengsheng, her father was posthumously given Qi former court gentleman Lingbao, Staff Officer for the Fast Cavalry, Left Guard General, enfeoffed Marquis of Wukang with five hundred households;
units.literal: In year 2 of Chengsheng, her father was posthumously given Qi former court gentleman Lingbao, Staff Officer for the Fast Cavalry, Left Guard General, enfeoffed Marquis of Wukang with five hundred households;

units.zh: 母陳氏，武康侯夫人。
units.en: mother née Chen, Lady of the Marquis of Wukang.
units.literal: mother née Chen, Lady of the Marquis of Wukang.

units.zh: 世祖徐妃
units.en: Shizu's Consort Xu
units.literal: Shizu's Consort Xu

units.zh: 世祖徐妃，諱昭佩，東海郯人也。
units.en: Shizu's consort Xu, taboo name Zhaopei, was from Tan in Donghai.
units.literal: Shizu's consort Xu, taboo name Zhaopei, was from Tan in Donghai.

units.zh: 祖孝嗣，太尉、枝江文忠公。
units.en: grandfather Xiaosi, Grand Commandant, Duke of Zhijiang the Cultured and Loyal.
units.literal: grandfather Xiaosi, Grand Commandant, Duke of Zhijiang the Cultured and Loyal.

units.zh: 父緄，侍中、信武將軍。
units.en: father Chun, Attendant-in-Ordinary, Trustworthy Martial General.
units.literal: father Chun, Attendant-in-Ordinary, Trustworthy Martial General.

units.zh: 天監十六年十二月，拜湘東王妃。
units.en: In the twelfth month, year 16 of Tianjian, she was appointed consort of the Prince of Xiangdong.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, year 16 of Tianjian, she was appointed consort of the Prince of Xiangdong.

units.zh: 生世子方等、益昌公主含貞。
units.en: She bore the heir Fangdeng and Princess Yichang Hanzhen.
units.literal: She bore the heir Fangdeng and Princess Yichang Hanzhen.

units.zh: 太清三年五月，被譴死，葬江陵瓦官寺。
units.en: In the fifth month of Taiqing year 3 she was put to death by imperial reproof and buried at Jiangling's Waguan Temple.
units.literal: In the fifth month of Taiping year 3, she was condemned to death and buried at Waguan Temple in Jiangling.

units.zh: 史臣曰
units.en: The historian says:
units.literal: The historian says:

units.zh: 史臣曰：后妃道贊皇風，化行天下，蓋取《葛覃》、《關雎》之義焉。
units.en: The historian writes: Empresses and consorts should uphold the court's moral influence and civilize the realm, following the spirit of "Ge Tan" and "Kuan-chiu."
units.literal: The historian says: The Way of empresses and consorts commends the royal wind and transforms the realm under Heaven—this broadly takes the meaning of "Ge Tan" and "Kuan-chiu."

units.zh: 至於穆貴嬪，徽華早著，誕育元良，德懋六宮，美矣。
units.en: Of Consort Mu the Precious: her merit shone early, she bore the heir apparent, and her virtue filled the six palaces—admirable indeed.
units.literal: As for Consort Mu the Precious, her fine splendor showed early; she bore the heir apparent; her virtue enriched the six palaces—beautiful indeed.

units.zh: 世祖徐妃之無行，自致殲滅，宜哉。
units.en: Shizu's Consort Xu, for her misdeeds, destroyed herself—as was fitting.
units.literal: As for Shizu's Consort Xu, her want of conduct brought destruction on herself—fitting indeed.

units.zh: 永元中，蕭遙光、崔慧景亂，累有戰功，以勳至前將軍。
units.en: In Yongyuan, Xiao Yaoguang and Cui Huijing rebelled; he won repeated battle merit and rose to front general.
units.literal: In Yongyuan, Xiao Yaoguang and Cui Huijing rebelled; he repeatedly had battle merit and through merit rose to front general.

units.zh: 又求「樂毅有後乎？」
units.en: He also asked: "Does Yue Yi have descendants?"
units.literal: He also asked: "Does Yue Yi have descendants?"

units.zh: 王出鎮京口，勱將隨之藩，范陽張纘時典選舉，勱造纘言別，纘嘉其風采，乃曰：「王生才地，豈可游外府乎？」
units.en: When the prince went out to hold Jiangkou, Mo was to accompany him to the fief; Zhang Zuan of Fanyang then controlled appointments. Mo came to take leave of him, and Zuan, struck by his bearing, said, "A man of your talent and station—how can he be left to wander in an outer princely house?"
units.literal: When the prince went out to hold Jiangkou, Mo was about to follow to the principality; Zhang Zuan of Fanyang then held selection offices; Mo went to bid Zuan farewell; Zuan admired his presence and said: "Master Wang's talent and standing—how can he wander in an outer princely house?"

units.zh: 俄而荊州刺史沈攸之作亂，高帝謂淹曰：「天下紛紛若是，君謂何如？」
units.en: Soon Jing inspector Shen Youzhi rose in arms; Gaodi asked Yan, "The world is chaos like this—what is your view?"
units.literal: Before long Jing inspector Shen Youzhi rebelled; Gaodi said to Yan, "The realm is in such turmoil—what do you think?"

units.zh: 昇明初，齊帝輔政，聞其才，召爲尚書駕部郎、驃騎參軍事。
units.en: At the start of Ascendant Bright, with Qi's emperor as regent, he heard of Yan and made him secretariat director of the imperial equipage and valiant-cavalry staff officer.
units.literal: At the start of the Ascendant Bright era, when Qi's emperor held regency, he heard of Yan's talent and summoned him as Masters of Writing director of the imperial equipage and valiant-cavalry staff officer.

units.zh: 太祖高皇帝篤猶子之愛，降家人之慈；
units.en: Grand Ancestor Gao cherished a nephew as a son and gave the kindness of kin under one roof;
units.literal: Grand Ancestor Emperor Gao cherished the love due a nephew-son and granted the kindness shown within a household;

units.zh: 到京師，司空徐孝嗣見而異之，曰：「祖逖之流也。」
units.en: At the capital, Minister of Works Xu Xiaosi took notice and said, "This is Zu Ti's kind of man."
units.literal: On reaching the capital, Minister of Works Xu Xiaosi saw him and was struck, saying, "A man in the mold of Zu Ti."

units.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。
units.en: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
units.literal: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.

units.zh: 時東昏皆下在所，使迫遣之，值義師已近，故並得不到。
units.en: By then Emperor Donghun was confined at the palace; messengers were sent to hurry them, but the righteous army was already near, so neither was reached.
units.literal: By then Emperor Donghun was under house arrest at the palace; messengers were sent to hurry them, but the righteous army was already near, so neither could be fetched.

units.zh: 三年，又詔徵朏爲侍中、太子少傅，胤散騎常侍、太子詹事。
units.en: In the third year another edict summoned Fei as attendant-in-ordinary and junior tutor to the crown prince, and Yin as regular palace attendant-in-ordinary and crown prince household superintendent.
units.literal: In the third year another edict summoned Fei as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince, and Yin as Regular Palace Attendant-in-Ordinary and Crown Prince Household Superintendent.

units.zh: 永明初，衛將軍王儉領丹陽尹，復引爲主簿。
units.en: Early in Yongming, Wang Jian of the guards, as Danyang intendant, drew him back as chief clerk.
units.literal: Early Yongming, General of the Guards Wang Jian took Danyang as intendant and again recruited him as chief clerk.

units.zh: 儉雅欽重昉，以爲當時無輩。
units.en: Jian prized him deeply and said no man of the time matched him.
units.literal: Jian deeply admired Fang and thought there was no equal in the age.

units.zh: 五世祖湛，宋左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，忠簡公。
units.en: His fifth-generation ancestor Zhan had been Song's left grand master of the palace and a grandee opening the mansion with ceremonial parity to the three offices, posthumously titled the loyal and simple duke.
units.literal: His fifth-generation ancestor Zhan was Song Left Grand Master of the Palace, Grandee Opening the Mansion with Ceremonial Parity to the Three Offices, the loyal and simple Duke.

units.zh: 方等身遇亂兵，斃於行陣，殞于吳局。
units.en: Fangdeng ran into mutinous troops, was killed in battle, and died in the Wu campaign.
units.literal: Fangdeng encountered mutinous troops and fell in the battle line, perishing in the Wu affair.

units.zh: 方此非冤，聞問號怛，惟增摧憤，念以兼悼，當何可稱。
units.en: Even if his death was not unjust, the news made me cry out in grief; sorrow and rage only grew. When I think of this added loss, what words could be enough?
units.literal: At such a time, though this was no wrongful death, upon hearing the news I cried out in grief; sorrow and indignation only increased—when I think of this added grief, what words suffice?

units.zh: 太宗簡文皇帝諱綱，字世纘，小字六通，高祖第三子，昭明太子母弟也。
units.en: Taizong Emperor Jianwen, personal name Gang, courtesy name Shizuan, childhood name Liutong, was Gaozu's third son and Zhaoming Crown Prince's younger brother by the same mother.
units.literal: The Taizong Emperor Jianwen was tabooed Gang, style name Shizuan, childhood name Liutong; he was the third son of the Gaozu and a uterine younger brother of Crown Prince Zhaoming.

units.zh: 三年四月乙巳，昭明太子薨。
units.en: On yisi in the fourth month of year 3 Crown Prince Zhaoming died.
units.literal: In the fourth month, day yisi, year 3, Crown Prince Zhaoming died.

units.zh: 所著《昭明太子傳》五卷，《諸王傳》三十卷，《禮大義》二十卷，《老子義》二十卷，《莊子義》二十卷，《長春義記》一百卷，《法寶連璧》三百卷，並行於世焉。
units.en: His works included Biography of the Heir Apparent Zhaoming in five scrolls, Biographies of the Princes in thirty scrolls, Great Meaning of the Rites in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Laozi in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Zhuangzi in twenty scrolls, Recorded Meaning of Eternal Spring in one hundred scrolls, and Treasured Laws Linked Pearls in three hundred scrolls—all circulated in his day.
units.literal: His works included Biography of the Heir Apparent Zhaoming in five scrolls, Biographies of the Princes in thirty scrolls, Great Meaning of the Rites in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Laozi in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Zhuangzi in twenty scrolls, Recorded Meaning of Eternal Spring in one hundred scrolls, and Treasured Laws Linked Pearls in three hundred scrolls—all circulated in his time.

units.zh: 乙亥，立桂陽公義真為廬陵王，彭城公義隆為宜都王，第四皇子義康為彭城王。
units.en: On the day yihai, the Duke of Guiyang, Yizhen, was established as Prince of Luling; the Duke of Pengcheng, Yilong, as Prince of Yidu; the fourth prince, Yikang, as Prince of Pengcheng.
units.literal: On the day yihai, the Duke of Guiyang, Yizhen, was established as Prince of Luling; the Duke of Pengcheng, Yilong, as Prince of Yidu; the fourth prince, Yikang, as Prince of Pengcheng.

units.zh: 八月戊午，西中郎將、荊州刺史宜都王義隆進號鎮西將軍。
units.en: In the eighth month, on the day wuwu, General of the Western Interior, Governor of Jing Province, Prince of Yidu Yilong was advanced to General Who Stabilizes the West.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuwu, the General of the Western Interior, Governor of Jing Province, Prince of Yidu Yilong was advanced to General Who Stabilizes the West.

units.zh: 服闋，為始興王濬後軍長史，領南下邳太守。
units.en: After completing mourning, he became chief clerk in the Rear Army of Jun, Prince of Shixing, while concurrently serving as Administrator of Southern Xiapi.
units.literal: When the mourning period was completed, he became Chief Clerk in the Rear Army of Jun, Prince of Shixing, and concurrently served as Administrator of Southern Xiapi.

units.zh: 及濬為揚州，未親政事，悉以委曄。
units.en: When Jun took charge of Yang Province, he was not yet personally managing government affairs and entrusted them all to Ye.
units.literal: When Jun became governor of Yang Province, he had not yet personally handled affairs of government, and entrusted all of them to Ye.

units.zh: 順皇帝諱準，字仲謀，[1]小字智觀，明帝第三子也。
units.en: Emperor Shun, taboo name Zhun, courtesy name Zhongmou, [1] childhood name Zhiguan, was the third son of Emperor Ming.
units.literal: Emperor Shun, taboo name Zhun, courtesy name Zhongmou, [1] childhood name Zhiguan, was the third son of Emperor Ming.

units.zh: 東魏主不堪憂辱，詠謝靈運詩曰：「韓亡子房奮，秦帝魯連恥。
units.en: Unable to bear the anguish and humiliation, the Eastern Wei emperor recited a poem of Xie Lingyun: "When Han perished Zhang Liang rose in zeal; before the Qin emperor Lu Zhong felt shame.
units.literal: Unable to bear the anguish and humiliation, the Eastern Wei emperor recited a poem of Xie Lingyun: "When Han perished Zhang Liang rose in zeal; before the Qin emperor Lu Zhong felt shame.

units.zh: 昔蕭何之鎮關中，荀彧之居許下，不亦異於是乎！
units.en: Long ago Xiao He guarded Guanzhong and Xun Yu held Xudu — were they not utterly unlike this?
units.literal: In old days when Xiao He guarded Guanzhong and Xun Yu dwelt at Xudu — were they not utterly unlike this?

units.zh: 壬辰，封當陽公大心為尋陽郡王，石城公大款為江夏郡王，寧國公大臨為南海郡王，臨城公大連為南郡王，西豊公大春為安陸郡王，新塗公大成為山陽郡王，臨湘公大封為宜都郡王。
units.en: On renchen Duke Daxin of Dangyang became Prince of Xunyang, Duke Dakuan of Shicheng Prince of Jiangxia, Duke Dalin of Ningguo Prince of Nanhai, Duke Dalian of Lincheng Prince of Nan commandery, Duke Dachun of Xifeng Prince of Anlu, Duke Dacheng of Xintu Prince of Shanyang, and Duke Dafeng of Linxiang Prince of Yidu.
units.literal: On renchen Duke of Dangyang Daxin was enfeoffed as Prince of Xunyang commandery, Duke of Shicheng Dakuan as Prince of Jiangxia, Duke of Ningguo Dalin as Prince of Nanhai, Duke of Lincheng Dalian as Prince of Nan commandery, Duke of Xifeng Dachun as Prince of Anlu, Duke of Xintu Dacheng as Prince of Shanyang, Duke of Linxiang Dafeng as Prince of Yidu.

units.zh: 六月辛巳，以南郡王大連行揚州事。
units.en: On xinsi in the sixth month Prince Dalian of Nan commandery was put in charge of Yangzhou affairs.
units.literal: In the sixth month, day xinsi, Prince of Nan commandery Dalian was assigned to handle Yangzhou affairs.

units.zh: 是月，以南郡王大連為江州刺史。
units.en: That month Prince Dalian of Nan commandery was made Jiangzhou inspector.
units.literal: That month Prince of Nan commandery Dalian was made Jiangzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 遣使害南海王大臨于吳郡，南郡王大連于姑孰，安陸王大春於會稽，新興王大莊於京口。
units.en: Envoys were sent to kill Prince Dailin of Nanhai at Wu, Prince Dalian of Nanjun at Gudu, Prince Dachun of Anlu at Kuaiji, and Prince Dazhuang of Xinxing at Jingkou.
units.literal: Envoys were sent to kill Prince of Nanhai Dailin at Wu commandery, Prince of Nanjun Dalian at Gudu, Prince of Anlu Dachun at Kuaiji, and Prince of Xinxing Dazhuang at Jingkou.

units.zh: 高祖義師起，茂私於張弘策，勸高祖迎和帝，高祖以爲不然，語在《高祖紀》。
units.en: When Gaozu raised the righteous army, Mao privately urged Zhang Hongce to have Gaozu welcome Emperor He; Gaozu disagreed, as told in the Annals of Gaozu.
units.literal: When Gaozu's righteous army rose, Mao privately told Zhang Hongce to urge Gaozu to welcome Emperor He; Gaozu thought otherwise—the account is in the Annals of Gaozu.

units.zh: 王司徒清虛寡欲，善於全己，昔曹參亦綜此道，著畫一之稱也。
units.en: He praised Wang Dao's quiet survival craft.
units.literal: Director Wang Dao is clear-minded with few desires, skilled at preserving himself—like Han's Cao Shen who earned praise for consistent rule.

units.zh: 按梁簡文帝長子大器封宣城郡王，見《梁書·哀太子傳》。
units.en: The Book of Liang's biography of the lamented crown prince shows Jianwen's eldest son Daqi enfeoffed as prince of Xuancheng.
units.literal: According to the Biography of the Lamented Crown Prince in the Book of Liang, the eldest son of Emperor Jianwen, Daqi, was enfeoffed as Prince of Xuancheng commandery.
